Features
--------
- Thread-safe via a re-entrant lock (RLock) so re-entrant calls are safe.
- LRU eviction when the cache exceeds its maximum size.
- Per-entry TTL: each entry expires independently after its TTL elapses.
- Optional default TTL applied when a per-call TTL is not given.
- Type hints throughout, generic over key/value types.
